name: Sex Knight~Prey of the Lustful Nobles~
detailed_description:
▌ Story

Militia―― a newbie knight.
Militia has always looked up to the highest order of knights, the "holy knights."
Militia works to fulfil her knightly duties alongside her superior, Giselle, and her fellow knight, Mei.
But, there's a rumor that if you want to become a higher order of knight, you must service nobles with your body......?

▌How to Play

The goal is to defeat the final boss and clear the game.

During battles with enemies that have a heart icon above their heads, there is a chance for lewd events to occur randomly.

Additionally, talking to NPCs in town who have a heart icon above their heads will also trigger lewd events.

 

▌ Highlights

・Erotic combat
There will be enemies that attempt pervert attacks on Militia.
If her clothes are damaged in combat, she might be assaulted......!
She won't be able to move after being forced to cum, and will look like a slut.

・Avoid erotic combat with your commands!
After some of the enemies use perverted attacks (erotic attacks), you will see command prompts.
If you input the commands successfully, Militia will avoid being assaulted by perverts, and escape her fate......!
There is no time limit to command inputs, so take your time!

・Chastity

Militia has "chastity."When this stat is lowered, she will do more lewd acts,and her reactions will change when raped……♪

・Erotic state
This records stats like the number of erotic events Militia has gone through.
You can also check "first time" and "most recent" events!

 

▌ Characters

✦ Militia(heroine) ✦
A girl born in a small village.
She was rescued by a band of knights passing by when her village was attacked by bandits.
She'd been saved by Giselle before, so she looked up to the knights, and joined them.
Her goal is to become a holy knight, the highest order of knights.

✦ Mei ✦
A knight that joined at the same time as our heroine.
She likes gossip, and gives all sorts of advice to our heroine.

✦ Giselle ✦
Once the greatest holy knight in the order.
She has quit being a holy knight, and now instructs junior and intermediate knights.
